links.outcome: Change in LLM recommendation category under equivalent gain/loss framing, paraphrases, repeated generations
links.effect: Gain-loss framing changed the recommendation category in 32.4% of complete groups across seven LLMs; effects persisted under conversational paraphrases and exceeded repeated-generation variability.
links.quote: Across seven LLMs, gain-loss framing changes the recommendation category in 32.4% of complete groups, with most changes involving uncertainty rather than direct reversals.

unlisted_practices: Probability canonicalization of prompts to reduce framing sensitivity in LLM decision support

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM decision advice across high-stakes domains including healthcare, testing how gain-loss framing causes inconsistency and showing that probability canonicalization prompt preprocessing mitigates framing sensitivity.
